title: Included assignment filter matches no device in its target group

report.title: {Items.Count} included {Plural(Items.Count, 'filter matches', 'filters match')} no device in a target group

messages.businessImpact: An included filter can match devices elsewhere in the tenant yet match none in the group it narrows. The policy then looks assigned but reaches no device through that assignment.
remediation: Compare the filter rule with the device properties in its assigned group.
Correct the filter rule or group membership where their intersection is empty.
messages.cannotSee: The filter evaluation is tenant-wide. This rule checks only included configuration-profile filters assigned to known device-only groups; user and mixed groups can reach devices through users and are excluded. A filter matching more than 500 devices, an incomplete evaluation, missing managed-device identity or unknown group membership skips this check rather than claiming a clear outcome. It does not limit the intersection to an assessment's device scope.
